summary: Citizen-Service Government adopted (CC-PRIN-38, CC-DEC-083, CC-DEV-154–175, expanding CC-DCC-23): ordinary working people can serve without sacrificing livelihood, business, family, or retirement. Separates temporary democratic leadership from professional administration. Eighteen reforms + Citizen Public Service Commission. Operational principle: Serve without sacrifice. Govern without privilege. Return without penalty. Complements CC-PRIN-37. Surfaces /citizen-service/. Phase 2 PARTIAL; baseline 2/86; legal/modeling 0%.
integrity_note: No invented leave formulas, replacement-fund amounts, or office-benefit statistics. Architecture ≠ evidence.
